entry.title: Updated: dsh-human-task
entry.summary: Human-in-the-loop tools (`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog. Exact install spec: github:ywgatustcbbs/dsh-human-task. Source event: dsh-market/dsh-market; changed: sources.
